levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: Two routes to Ibn Aslam, each repeating its names: no shared tail. The text has no saying here, only the chain
«خادم الرضا عليه السلام» is an epithet of Muhammad b. Zayd, not a link to the Imam
«رضي الله عنه» formulas are left out; «أبي» (the Saduq's father in the text) is a bare relation, not identified
